about_the_game:
Step away from the fields and into the lively heart of Zalesie! In this DLC, Kazimierz can open his very own tavern – a place where food, drink, and entertainment flow in equal measure.

Your regulars are the colorful folks of Zalesie, each with their own tastes and quirks. Keep them happy with hearty meals and strong drinks, then spice up the evening with a variety of tavern games:

  • Card duels for the sharp-minded,

  • Arm wrestling matches for the strong,

  • Drinking contests for the brave,

  • Or the classic “three cups, find the ball” for those who trust their luck.

Of course, no tavern would be complete without music, dancing, and a chance to raise your mug high!

Customize and decorate your space to create the perfect atmosphere, and watch your profits grow based on the number and satisfaction of your guests. Running the tavern is entirely optional, ideal for those long autumn evenings or quiet winter months. And if Kazimierz happens to be married, his wife can take over management while he’s busy elsewhere.

Raise a glass, keep the patrons smiling, and make your tavern the beating heart of village life!
